answer.reason: The verses tell of Jeroboam's rise, his division of the kingdom and his golden calves, so a line of the chief events is possible.

clauses.english: was told by the prophet Ahijah that he would receive ten tribes of the kingdom
clauses.quote: I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee

clauses.english: fled into Egypt from Solomon, who sought to kill him
clauses.quote: Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt

clauses.english: was made king over all Israel when the tribes broke from the house of David
clauses.quote: made him king over all Israel

clauses.english: made two golden calves and set them in Bethel and Dan

doubts: The summary already names him king of Israel, so the clause on being made king rests on the event of the tribes' choice, which is not just the office.
Verses 1KI 11:28 and 2KI 14:23-26 partly concern another Jeroboam (son of Joash); I left out the latter and the later verses naming the sins of Jeroboam in other kings' stories.
